### Environmental Compliance Program

#### Introduction
GreenScape Solutions is committed to protecting the environment and ensuring compliance with all relevant environmental regulations in Malaysia. This Environmental Compliance Program outlines our policies, procedures, and responsibilities to maintain environmental sustainability and regulatory adherence.

#### Regulatory Framework
The environmental regulations in Malaysia are stringent and require adherence to various standards. GreenScape Solutions operates in Petaling Jaya, Selangor, with the postcode 40150. Our compliance program is designed to meet these regulatory requirements, ensuring that our operations align with the environmental standards set by the government.

#### Policy Statements
GreenScape Solutions is dedicated to minimizing our environmental impact. We adhere to the principles of waste reduction, emissions control, and spill response. Our policies are designed to ensure that all our activities are conducted in an environmentally responsible manner.

#### Responsibilities
The management of GreenScape Solutions is responsible for ensuring that all employees are aware of and comply with the environmental regulations. Employees are expected to follow the procedures outlined in this program and report any environmental issues to the designated environmental compliance officer.

#### Procedures

##### Waste Management
All waste generated by GreenScape Solutions must be managed in accordance with the waste management procedures outlined in this program. This includes the proper disposal of hazardous and non-hazardous waste.

##### Emissions Control
GreenScape Solutions is committed to controlling and reducing emissions. We implement emission control measures to ensure that our operations do not exceed the regulatory limits set by the government.

##### Spill Response
In the event of a spill, GreenScape Solutions has a spill response plan in place. This plan includes immediate containment, cleanup, and reporting procedures to minimize environmental impact. All employees are trained on the spill response procedures to ensure a quick and effective response.

#### Training Requirements
All employees of GreenScape Solutions receive training on environmental compliance. This training includes understanding the regulatory framework, waste management procedures, emissions control measures, and spill response protocols. The training is conducted regularly to ensure that all employees are up-to-date with the latest environmental regulations and best practices. Employees are expected to complete the training within the first month of employment, and there is a refresher course every year.

#### Record Keeping
GreenScape Solutions maintains comprehensive records of all environmental activities. These records include waste management logs, emissions reports, and spill response documentation. All records are kept in accordance with the regulatory requirements and are available for inspection by regulatory authorities.

#### Audits and Inspections
Regular audits and inspections are conducted to ensure compliance with the environmental regulations.
